messages.subject: VEC model estimation with constant both in the VAR and in the long-term relationship
parts:
Cordial greeting,

I have tried to estimate a VEC with constant both in the long-term relationship and in the var, but when I specify it in the VECM function of the package it seems to only take one of the two specifications.

vec <- VECM (data, lag, r = 1, include = "const", estim = "ML", LRinclude = "const")  

I wanted to know if there is any way I can estimate it.
I would appreciate your answer.
